slot.brief: A Wheatstone bridge with one unknown resistance; use the balanced-bridge condition to find that resistance from the other three arms.

stem: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced. Its upper-left, lower-left and upper-right arms are $a=3\ \Omega$, $b=6\ \Omega$ and $c=9\ \Omega$ respectively; the lower-right arm is $x$. Find $x$.

verdicts.working: For a balanced bridge, a/b = c/x. Thus x = bc/a = (6×9)/3 = 18 Ω.

working:
$$\dfrac{a}{b}=\dfrac{c}{x}$$
$$x=\dfrac{bc}{a}=\dfrac{(6)(9)}{3}=18\ \Omega$$

Independent check: For a balanced bridge, a/b = c/x. Thus x = bc/a = (6×9)/3 = 18 Ω.
